C0794.title: Salesloft Drift Data Breach: OAuth Token Abuse Impacts 700+ Enterprises
C0794.summary: In August 2025, threat group UNC6395 breached Salesloft's GitHub account and stole OAuth tokens for customer integrations on the Drift platform, gaining access to Salesforce data of over 700 enterprises including Cloudflare and Palo Alto Networks.
